narrative.northStar: One drawing sheet documenting a body of numerical work
narrative.overview: A framed sheet with zone references, a title block for identity, simulations as labelled views, a revision-table timeline and a parts grid of tools. Ink on cool plotter paper; red only for state.
keyCharacteristics: zone band with numbers and section letters
cells and rules, no radii or shadows

rules.name: The Redline Rule
rules.body: Red marks what is active or wanted now, never decoration.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Lines are ink, never grey; weight (1 / 1.5 / 3px) carries hierarchy.

dos: Keep new elements as cells and rules in ink.
donts: No pills, rounded cards, soft shadows or eyebrows above headings.
